description: Static snapshot of Mio built-in provider presets from src/rpc.rs PROVIDER_PRESETS. Does not read user credentials.

providers.name: antigravity
providers.notesZh: 凭据查找优先级：MIO_CONFIG_DIR > XDG_CONFIG_HOME/mio > ~/.config/mio；支持通过 mio --import-antigravity ~/.pi/agent 导入已有凭据。已有 profile 可提供默认 model。实际可用模型与档位取决于账号权限；一般 thinking 仅在 Antigravity 适配器中消费生效，不声称完整支持。
providers.notesEn: Credential search priority: MIO_CONFIG_DIR > XDG_CONFIG_HOME/mio > ~/.config/mio; supports importing existing profiles via mio --import-antigravity ~/.pi/agent. An existing profile can provide a default model. Available models and levels depend on account entitlements; generic thinking is consumed only by the Antigravity adapter without claiming universal support.

providers.name: openai
providers.notesZh: OpenAI 官方 Chat Completions 接口，原生支持函数调用与流式事件；思考档位由 Antigravity 专享，OpenAI 驱动忽略通用 thinking 预算。
providers.notesEn: Official OpenAI Chat Completions API with native tool-calling; thinking levels are Antigravity-only and ignored by standard OpenAI driver.

providers.name: anthropic
providers.notesZh: ⚠️ Mio 采用通用 OpenAI Chat 驱动。原生 api.anthropic.com 端点格式不兼容，必须搭配 OpenAI 兼容网关并显式指定 --base-url https://your-gateway.example/v1。
providers.notesEn: ⚠️ Mio uses a standard OpenAI Chat driver. Native api.anthropic.com endpoint is incompatible; you must provide an OpenAI-compatible gateway via explicit --base-url.

providers.name: google
providers.notesZh: 使用 Google Generative Language 提供的 OpenAI 兼容接口 (/v1beta/openai)。支持通过 GEMINI_API_KEY 或 GOOGLE_API_KEY 接入。
providers.notesEn: Uses Google Generative Language OpenAI-compatible endpoint (/v1beta/openai). Configured via GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY.

providers.name: deepseek
providers.notesZh: DeepSeek 官方 API 兼容 OpenAI 格式。支持 deepseek-chat 及内置推理模型 deepseek-reasoner。
providers.notesEn: Official DeepSeek API (OpenAI-compatible). Supports deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner.

providers.name: openrouter
providers.notesZh: 多模型聚合网关，统一使用 openrouter.ai/api/v1 端点接入各类上游模型。
providers.notesEn: Multi-provider aggregation gateway routed through openrouter.ai/api/v1.

providers.name: groq
providers.notesZh: Groq 超高速 LPU 推理端点，兼容 OpenAI 格式协议。
providers.notesEn: Groq ultra-fast LPU inference endpoint, OpenAI-compatible.

providers.name: xai
providers.notesZh: xAI 官方 Grok API 接口，完全兼容 OpenAI 协议。
providers.notesEn: xAI official Grok API endpoint, fully OpenAI-compatible.

providers.name: mistral
providers.notesZh: Mistral AI 官方端点，支持 Codestral 与 Mistral Large。
providers.notesEn: Mistral AI official endpoint, supports Codestral and Mistral Large.

providers.name: ollama
providers.notesZh: 本地运行的 Ollama 实例（默认 http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1），无需外部密钥即可离线使用。
providers.notesEn: Locally running Ollama instance (default http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1), completely offline without remote keys.
